text:
Wait, `git diff HEAD --name-only` shows only command_validate, bundle tests. But logger.h etc are modified on disk yet git doesn't see them. That means git thinks they're unchanged. Possibly the filesystem content is overlaid but stat cache? `git diff` uses content hash though. Unless there's a clean filter that reverses changes? Unlikely.

Hmm, maybe I'm on a different branch where these files already contain the changes? Let me check `git show HEAD:src/logger.h`.
